title: 外篇之奉天七六九 上第一百七十五章 奉天四十七年
content_zh:
“呼呜——”绿皮货运火车鸣着汽笛，带着滚滚浓烟，载着木材和煤炭，咣当咣当向南驶去。
这是一处比较偏僻的站台，落叶打着旋落下，远方钟楼的尖塔上，几只白鸽追逐着盘旋而起，向蓝天白云的无尽远方飞去。
站台附近的渣子公路上，停着一排十几辆黑色轿车，上面的车牌，“齐”字打头极为醒目，也就表示，车辆不是属于齐人便是属于齐人公司派驻在此的机构。
大齐帝国虽然造就了数不清的财富，全世界科研成果有百分之九十以上出自大齐帝国为核心的中华联邦，但明显隶属于某一个人或者某一个组织的十几辆最新型高档轿车，还是有些惊世骇俗。
毕竟，汽车从雏形诞生到现在，从蒸汽动力汽车到现今内燃机汽油车，也不过百多年时间。
虽然大齐帝国汽车产量每年已经超过百万量，但以卡车、敞篷吉普、普通轿车等等为主，奢华轿车并不多见。
便是帝国最繁华的城市，这种最新型高档轿车也是凤毛麟角，也仅仅最上流阶层才能养得起这种售价高达数千银元的奢侈品。
更莫说，这里是西宁湖（里海）东的哈萨克国。
车队最中间一辆轿车里，陆宁微微闭目靠在座椅上。
七百多年了，如果按照前世来说，现今应该是十八世纪，但大齐七百多年前科技提速，使得这个世界，现今的科技发展，大概和历史上二战期间相仿，当然，有的科技点进步的更快，有一些，可能就慢一些。
现今全世界，纪年都是公历769年，大齐对这个世界的影响力，由此可见一斑。
中华联邦内，则纪年奉天七百六十九年。
中华联邦，便是以大齐帝国为主体，加上数十个华人为主体的小国家以及一些非华人的城市国家组成。
其中，北美便有二十多个华人国家，此外便是南洋，也有十几个华人国家。
美洲，为大齐命名，美丽之洲的意思。
此外在北海、波罗的海、地中海，同样有一些城市国家是中华联邦成员，这些城市国家未必是华人占多数，多元化色彩很浓，都是由当年自由城市联邦发展而来。
又有现今陆宁身处的哈萨克国。
曾经的乌古斯人和基马克联盟的地域，后来大齐帝国曾经放逐大批西域族群进入这片地域。
两百年前，哈萨克建国，现今也是中华联盟的成员国之一。
当然，比之陆宁认知里的哈萨克，这个哈萨克国要小许多。

除了大齐帝国外，中华联邦成员国，都是尊大齐皇帝为名义上的国家元首，但所有成员国，都有完整的独立自治权。
大齐帝国，有各级议会，但其作用，仅仅是监督各级执政机构的运行，官员任命系统，还是一种从低到高的渐进提拔，内阁总理，通常十年一换，由帝国皇帝从内阁成员中任命，除此之外，帝国皇帝还负责任命帝国最高法大法官，帝国大法官共七人，没有重大失误的话通常是终身制。
但具体行政权、司法权等等，帝国皇帝便没有任何参与其中的权力了。
帝国武装，常备军为帝国皇家禁军，海陆空三军，帝国皇帝为名义上的最高统帅，内阁总理，则为三军总司令，但军方一直对皇室忠心耿耿，当然，皇室在民众中的威望更是无与伦比，如果不是有祖训，帝国皇帝重新掌权废除立宪法律简直易如反掌。
这也是没办法的事，帝国没有变成君权神国，已经是因为开国皇帝早就有祖训在内府记载的明明白白。
开国祖皇帝是天帝临凡，这一点在全世界都没有疑问，实际上，海外的天道教国家才更疯狂更狂热。
实际上，现今所有国民也都是深信，祖皇帝实际上还活在世间，不知道在哪里逍遥潜居了而已。
就在百年前，祖皇帝仍然是帝国皇帝，只是，由皇室的“太子监国”真正执行国君权力，祖皇帝则每隔十年或者几十年，都会在汴京亮相向国民发表重要训诫，百年前最后一次亮相更留下了珍贵的影像资料，和数百年前宫廷画师所画的祖皇帝图画一般无二。
直到百年前，祖皇帝最后一次在帝国电台发表对全帝国子民的最后训诫，宣布正式退位，由当时的太子监国，他的第三十三代孙继位，同时，对当时思想激荡的社会热点问题发表了演说。
如火如荼的一夫一妻运动得到祖皇帝的肯定，由此一夫一妻制度写入宪法。
天道教教宗因为频频发表出格的****的激烈言论而被祖皇帝训斥，随之被罢黜，天道教从此不再有中枢机构和教宗，仅仅由帝国皇帝从此担任天道教守护者之名。
东海百行集团也终于随着祖皇帝的训诫，而加快了国有化进程，皇室仅仅占股百分之二十，正式放弃了八成的巨额财富。
各地的皇庄，许多也被皇室放弃，唯一保存完整的皇庄便是昆仑皇庄，也就是当年祖皇帝有时候称为澳大利亚的巨大岛屿，或者说，独立的大陆。
这七百六十万平方公里的岛屿，整个属于皇室，祖皇帝的祖训里也早提到，昆仑皇庄永远为自己的子孙后裔所有，一切继承帝国遗产的执政者，不得违反此约。
显然，智慧之士，都知道，这是祖皇帝担心千万年后，若子孙不肖，还是能为他们留有安身立命之所，想来，便是千万年后，甚至推翻了帝国统治但继承了帝国遗产之人，也没人敢违反此约。
祖皇帝的威望，简直超越了一切族群、阶层、利益之见，便是后世有反叛者，也必然要打着祖皇帝的旗号来建立更美好世界，而不是反其道行之。
而百年前祖皇帝发表最后一次训诫就此消失无踪后，也不知道多少子民，悲痛下得了大病，甚至由此伤病而死的，也并不鲜见。
这还是都知道祖皇帝隐居或云游四海，若真是祖皇帝离世，要追随祖皇帝于九泉下的，怕是大有人在。
或许，祖皇帝当年宣布退位，也有这种考量。
content_en:
"Woo-hoo--" The green freight train blew its whistle, carrying thick smoke and carrying wood and coal as it clanked southward.
This is a relatively remote platform. The fallen leaves are swirling down. On the spire of the bell tower in the distance, several white pigeons are chasing and circling, flying towards the endless distance of the blue sky and white clouds.
On the Zhazi Highway near the platform, there are a row of more than a dozen black cars parked. The license plates on them, starting with the word "Qi", are very eye-catching, which means that the vehicles either belong to Qi Ren or the organization stationed here by Qi Ren Company.
Although the Daqi Empire has created countless wealth, and more than 90% of the world's scientific research results come from the Chinese Federation with the Daqi Empire at its core, a dozen of the latest high-end cars that are obviously affiliated with a certain person or organization are still a bit shocking.
After all, it only takes more than a hundred years from the prototype of the automobile to the present, from steam-powered cars to today's internal combustion engine gasoline cars.
Although the Daqi Empire's automobile production has exceeded one million units every year, they are mainly trucks, convertible jeeps, ordinary cars, etc., and luxury cars are rare.
Even in the most prosperous city in the empire, such latest high-end cars are rare, and only the upper class can afford such luxury goods, which cost thousands of silver dollars.
Not to mention, this is the Kazakh country east of Xining Lake (Caspian Sea).
In the car in the middle of the motorcade, Lu Ning closed his eyes slightly and leaned on the seat.
It has been more than seven hundred years. If we go by previous lives, it would be the eighteenth century now. However, the speed of science and technology in Daqi more than seven hundred years ago has made the world's current technological development roughly similar to that during World War II in history. Of course, some technological points have advanced faster, and some may have progressed slower.
Nowadays, the calendar year all over the world is 769 in the Gregorian calendar. The influence of Daqi on this world can be seen from this.
In the Chinese Federation, the year of Fengtian is 769 years.
The Chinese Federation is composed of the Qi Empire as the main body, plus dozens of small countries with Chinese as the main body, and some non-Chinese city-states.
Among them, there are more than twenty Chinese countries in North America, and there are also more than a dozen Chinese countries in Southeast Asia.
America, named after Daqi, means the beautiful continent.
In addition, in the North Sea, the Baltic Sea, and the Mediterranean, there are also some city-states that are members of the Chinese Federation. These city-states may not necessarily have a Chinese majority, and they are highly diversified. They were all developed from the Free City Federation.
There is also the country of Kazakhstan where Lu Ning is now.
It was once the area of ​​the Ogus and Kimak alliance. Later, the Daqi Empire expelled a large number of ethnic groups from the Western Regions into this area.
Two hundred years ago, Kazakhstan was founded and is now also a member of the China Alliance.
Of course, this Kazakh country is much smaller than the Kazakhstan Lu Ning knew.
With the exception of the Da Qi Empire, all member states of the Chinese Federation respect the Emperor of Da Qi as their nominal head of state, but all member states have complete independence and autonomy.
The Daqi Empire had parliaments at all levels, but their role was only to supervise the operation of the ruling institutions at all levels. The official appointment system was a gradual promotion from low to high. The prime minister of the cabinet was usually changed every ten years and was appointed by the emperor from among the cabinet members. In addition, the emperor was also responsible for appointing the emperor's supreme court justices. There were seven imperial justices. If there were no major mistakes, they were usually lifelong.
But in terms of specific administrative power, judicial power, etc., the emperor did not have any power to participate in them.
The imperial armed forces, the standing army is the Imperial Royal Guards, the navy, land and air force. The emperor is the nominal supreme commander, and the cabinet prime minister is the commander-in-chief of the three armed forces. However, the military has always been loyal to the royal family. Of course, the royal family's prestige among the people is unparalleled. If it were not for the ancestral precepts, it would be easy for the emperor to regain power and abolish the constitutional law.
There's nothing we can do about itAs a matter of fact, the reason why the empire did not turn into a kingdom of monarchical power was because the founding emperor had clearly recorded his ancestral precepts in his inner palace.
There is no doubt in the whole world that the founding emperor was the Emperor of Heaven. In fact, overseas Tiandao countries are even more crazy and fanatical.
In fact, all citizens today are convinced that the ancestor emperor is actually still alive in the world and is just living in hiding somewhere.
Just a hundred years ago, Emperor Zu was still the emperor of the empire. However, the royal family's "Prince Supervisor" truly executed the monarch's power. Emperor Zu would appear in Bianjing every ten or decades to deliver important admonitions to the people. His last appearance a hundred years ago left behind precious video materials, which were no different from the pictures of Emperor Zu that were painted by court painters hundreds of years ago.
It was not until a hundred years ago that Emperor Zu issued his final admonishment to the people of the empire on Imperial Radio for the last time, announcing his official abdication, and that the then Crown Prince would supervise the country and his thirty-third generation grandson would succeed him. At the same time, he also gave a speech on the hot social issues that agitated the minds of the time.
The raging monogamy movement was affirmed by Emperor Zu, and the monogamy system was written into the constitution.
The Pope of Tiandao Sect was reprimanded by the ancestor Emperor for frequently making extremely violent and violent remarks, and was subsequently deposed. Tiandao Sect no longer has a central organization and a pope, and the emperor only serves as the guardian of Tiandao Sect.
Donghai Baihang Group finally followed the instructions of Emperor Zu and accelerated the process of nationalization. The royal family only held 20% of the shares and officially gave up 80% of its huge wealth.
Many of the imperial estates in various places were abandoned by the royal family. The only imperial estate that has been completely preserved is the Kunlun Imperial Estate, which was the huge island that the ancestor emperor sometimes called Australia, or in other words, an independent continent.
The entire island of 7.6 million square kilometers belongs to the royal family. The ancestral precepts of the ancestral emperor also mentioned that the Kunlun Imperial Villa will always be owned by his descendants, and all rulers who inherit the empire's legacy must not violate this agreement.
Obviously, all wise people know that this is because the emperor is worried that if his descendants are unworthy thousands of years later, he will still be able to leave a place for them to settle down and live. Come to think of it, even if thousands of years later, even those who overthrew the rule of the empire but inherited the empire's legacy, no one would dare to violate this agreement.
The prestige of the ancestral emperor simply transcends all ethnic groups, classes, and interests. Even if there are rebels in future generations, they will definitely build a better world under the banner of the ancestral emperor, rather than doing the opposite.
After the emperor's last admonishment a hundred years ago disappeared without a trace, it was not uncommon for many of his people to suffer from serious illnesses due to grief, and even to die from these injuries.
It is still known that the ancestor emperor lived in seclusion or traveled around the world. If the ancestor emperor really passed away, there would be many people who would follow the ancestor emperor under the Nine Springs.
Perhaps Emperor Zu also had this consideration when he announced his abdication.
